scenes.sub: How e-bikes are changing the way cities move
scenes.narration: Every morning, millions of people choose a quieter way to get to work.

scenes.text: Cities are trading lanes for bikes
scenes.sub: Paris added over a thousand kilometres of bike lanes in five years.
scenes.narration: Cities are trading car lanes for bike lanes, and riders are showing up.
In Paris, e-bike trips have grown by two hundred and forty percent.
Riders stay for three reasons: it is faster, it is cheaper, and there is no parking to find.
A car costs nearly ten thousand dollars a year. An e-bike, about four hundred and fifty.
The quietest commute might also be the smartest.
